name: Dynamic Cables Ltd
title: Dynamic Cables Ltd - 540795 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 growth slowed to 7% reported (20% core) as greenfield plant slipped about 15 months to September 2026 and order book rose only 11% after March price-driven deferrals; capacity constrained in H1.

capex.peers_comment: Management said peers are reporting bigger capex each year, and that everybody in the industry, including us, must keep up capex.
capex.quote: there has been a delay in the capex, so there is no two doubts about it

triggers.label: Greenfield plant slips to September 2026
triggers.quote: we are kind of guiding that based on the developments at the site level, at the plant level, we should be able to go live by September

triggers.label: Order book up only 11%
triggers.quote: there has been a deferment of order booking from March, in the month of March because of the sudden spike in the prices of aluminium and PVC

triggers.label: Realisation growth 12% in Q4
triggers.quote: for quarter four, it is 12%. So, for the quarter, 12% is the realization growth and 8% volume growth for the core products

triggers.label: Exit from railway signaling cables
triggers.quote: we feel that competitive intensity is very high and it is better to move on to our power cable products

guidance.quote: We have always been giving a long-term guidance of 18% to 20% growth
we have always guided an operating profit of anywhere between 10.5% to 11% all throughout the year
we have guided for the peak capacity utilization to be around INR135 crores a month
we should be able to go live by September

prior_guidance_check.metric: Q2 FY26 commissioning of new plant
prior_guidance_check.quote: we are kind of guiding that based on the developments at the site level, at the plant level, we should be able to go live by September
that is what we have delivered also

red_flags.label: Net debt up QoQ; working capital borrowing
red_flags.quote: the entire borrowing which you look at is our working capital borrowings

red_flags.label: Gross margin down; deflects to EBITDA
red_flags.quote: you have to look at operating profit is the right measure actually because gross profit

red_flags.label: Employee expense optically down
red_flags.quote: so that is why it's not a decline as such, it is just proper way of accounting the expenditure

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on FY27 guidance
red_flags.quote: we have never been giving yearly guidances

evasions.topic: H1 FY27 growth vs H1 FY26
evasions.quote: we don't have a practice of giving any guidance, short-term guidance
you should not look at a quarter-on-quarter it's very, very difficult to kind of provide any kind of explanation
it will be difficult for us to discuss
